info.title: FestivePlate API
info.description: AI-powered food surplus prediction, rescue and redistribution for Bengaluru. Food-safety checks are automated *screening*, never certification. Sarvam / Flagsmith / NudgeBee integrations report their real connection state; anything simulated is labelled as such.
